Perform a scoped audit of the current 2025 BMW M5 driving lab after migration to iLuzionsX/Racing26. Focus on low-speed steering/braking stability and obvious physics regressions. Preserve AGENTS.md, PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md, and M5_VALIDATION.md as hard constraints. Do not change code unless there is a clear, evidence-based defect. If you propose a patch, keep it small, include deterministic regression coverage, and require npm run test:m5-validation:strict for any change that can affect overall M5 behavior.
